text: Hello Abbu, it's Ayesha. How are you today?
Not good, Ayesha. Everything feels heavy since your mother is gone.
I'm here, Abbu. Tell me what's on your mind.
I don't see the point in going on anymore.
That sounds very painful. Can you tell me more?
Sometimes I wish I wouldn't wake up in the morning.
Abbu, I care about you very much. You are not alone.
I know you do, beta. But the thoughts keep coming.
